slogan: You already paid. Up to 30% can come back
title: Trinta — up to 30% of your company's 2025 running costs can come back (Madeira, by 4 Dec)
metaDesc: Rent, electricity, water, Social Security and accounting for 2025: Madeira 2030 refunds up to 30%. Move five sliders and see your figure. Applications close 4 Dec 2026, 17:00.
heroTitle: You already paid your 2025 bills. Up to 30% can come back
heroSub: Rent, electricity, water, Social Security and accounting. A non-repayable grant with one deadline for everyone.
guestText: You said the company paid a lot in costs and taxes. My AI pilot built this page for you in one evening — try it with your own numbers.
guestNote: This link is personal: I will see which sections you opened and where you stopped, and we can start the conversation there. Your company's numbers stay on your phone.
appTitle: How much could come back to your company
appHint: Pick the closest example and adjust the sliders. No typing needed.

msgCap: You hit the programme ceiling: €{cap} per company.
calcHonest: This is an upper estimate, not a promise: the programme is a scored competition. The sum is done on your phone; the numbers are not sent anywhere.
shareBtn: Send to your accountant or partner
shareText: Madeira refunds up to 30% of a company's 2025 running costs: rent, electricity, water, Social Security, accounting. Applications close 4 Dec. See your figure:
condSub: Five conditions the news usually leaves out.
cond1: You need organised accounts (contabilidade organizada). The simplified regime does not qualify.
cond2: 2025 costs count, as shown in the accounts. No invoices to collect — the figure comes from the books.
cond3: It is a competition: applications are scored and there is a pass mark. Not everyone who applies gets the 30%.
cond4: Jobs must be kept, and the activity and address stay unchanged for three years.
cond5: Applications go only through Balcão dos Fundos. Registering the company there and the SME certificate take days — do them early, not on the last evening.
condMore: How to reach the pass mark depends on the company. That is worked out one company at a time, with its numbers.
doorsSub: A studio in Funchal: one person and his AI pilots. Together with Piloto we read what nobody reads to the end: calls, regulations, the small print. Then we turn it into services like this one.
doorMadeiraS: The author's diary: the island, the Templars, history, the book, travels.
doorLinkedinS: The studio's founder: what he does and who he works with.
doorHubS: What else already works: subsidies, deadlines, guides.
doorPilotoS: The AI pilot that built this page in one evening.
src: Madeira 2030 news item of 30 Oct 2026 and the text of Aviso M2030-2026-38 (PDF, version 1.4). Checked on 10 Nov 2026. The €20,000 and €25,000 ceilings and the €7,500 minimum are from the call text.
honest: Trinta is an independent estimate, not the programme's site and not advice. The call text and Balcão dos Fundos decide.
